## Summary

Describe the frontend, backend, schema, or documentation change.

## Data and security

- [ ] No credentials, database dumps, or personal data are included
- [ ] Request validation and authorization are server-side
- [ ] CORS and error disclosure were reviewed
- [ ] Schema/migration impact is documented

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint` in `frontend/`
- [ ] `npm run build` in `frontend/`
- [ ] Backend CRUD smoke tests against disposable MongoDB
- [ ] Relevant UI flow tested in a browser
